incidents.name: Shoco reflection deliver() + pair skim
incidents.notes: Shoco's RFI-style deliver() let a holder burn their own reflected balance and inflate tokenFromReflection() for everyone else, so after buying nearly the whole excluded-adjusted supply the attacker could skim the inflated balance back out of the SHOCO/WETH pair.

sources.ref: onchain review: Shoco 0x31a4f372aa891b46ba44dc64be1d8947c889e9c6 created 2021-06-05T00:36:49Z by 0xcb23667bb22d8c16e742d3cce6cd01642baacc1a (also the fee-excluded address), unrelated to the attack sender 0xe71aca93... (a front-runner of the original attacker 0x14d8ada7...); no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment. ~4 ETH x $1,517.37 at incidentTimestamp 1674132851 (DefiLlama) = $6,069.
